clue.text: Ruin atmosphere getting upset

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the word for atmosphere is turned round

parts.note: the mood of a place is its atmosphere

explanation.surface: A pleasant atmosphere is spoiled when everyone becomes upset.
explanation.definitionFit: Doom is ruin or destruction, a fate of utter downfall.

clue.text: Sweet daughter is first to perplex

parts.note: a comfit is a sugar-coated sweet

explanation.surface: A daughter's sweet treat is the first thing to puzzle her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is first' places the sweet after the daughter piece; 'first' is a charade link.
explanation.definitionFit: To discomfit is to unsettle, embarrass or perplex someone.

clue.text: Comfortingly met distressed star of 13, 25

indicators.note: distressed means damaged or upset, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A troubled film star is met with comforting words.
explanation.definitionFit: The American actor played Private Prewitt in the 1953 film of the novel, earning an Oscar nomination.

clue.text: Item found in medicine cupboard — toss sample out

indicators.note: out here means wrong or disordered, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone clearing a medicine cabinet is told to throw away a sample.
explanation.definitionFit: Epsom salts, magnesium sulphate, is a traditional household laxative and bath remedy kept with medicines.

clue.text: Improve in French given opportunity, missing start

parts.note: en is the French word for in

indicators.note: missing start means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a chance is an opportunity

explanation.surface: Someone improves their French when given a chance, but misses the beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: To enhance something is to improve or heighten its quality.

clue.text: Rod's back, entertaining 550

indicators.note: entertaining means holding as a guest, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: the spine is the backbone
D is 500 and L is 50 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A man called Rod has a sore back while hosting 550 guests.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rod's' looks like a man's name; it is the definition followed by 's for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A spindle is a slender rod on which thread is wound or that turns as an axle.

clue.text: Top person working in parade

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a march is a parade or procession
on means operating or working, as a machine switched on

explanation.surface: A senior figure at work takes part in a parade.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch, king or queen, is the person at the very top of a state.

clue.text: Internet nuisance trapped by honeypot — an undoing for novelist

indicators.note: trapped by means the nuisance sits inside the rearranged letters
undoing means taking apart, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a troll posts provocative messages online

explanation.surface: An online troublemaker is lured into a honeypot sting, which proves his undoing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victorian writer of the Barsetshire novels was a prolific English novelist.

clue.text: Strain is rising on first lady

indicators.note: in a down entry rising means the word reads upwards

parts.note: Eve was the first woman in the Bible

explanation.surface: Tension mounts for the president's wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strain' is a verb meaning to filter, not stress; 'first lady' is not a president's wife.
explanation.definitionFit: A sieve is used to strain liquids from solids, so to sieve is to strain.

clue.text: Hear what slurring soprano did in Asian city

indicators.note: hear tells us to listen to how the following phrase is pronounced

parts.note: a soprano sang high; said with slurred speech it comes out as '...'

explanation.surface: A tipsy soprano mumbles her high notes during a performance in an Asian city.
explanation.walkthrough: The slurring turns S into SH, so 'sang high' becomes a sound-alike of the Chinese port.
explanation.definitionFit: Shanghai is China's largest city, a major port on the Yangtze delta.

clue.text: Advertising spot

definitions.meaning: to spot something is to observe or see it

explanation.definitionFit: A notice can be an advertisement posted up, and to notice is to spot or observe.

clue.text: Source making old gear fashionable

parts.note: a rig is equipment or gear, as in a drilling rig
in means trendy or fashionable

explanation.surface: A source explains how vintage clothing became fashionable again.
explanation.definitionFit: An origin is the source or starting point from which something comes.

clue.text: Creature needing place to sleep over with utility

parts.note: a dorm, or dormitory, is a room for sleeping
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over
utility means usefulness, or use

explanation.surface: An animal that needs a bed and something practical to do.
explanation.walkthrough: The dormouse is famous for sleeping, as in Alice in Wonderland, so the place to sleep fits the creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The dormouse is a small hibernating rodent, an example of a creature.

clue.text: Take action to court girl

definitions.meaning: to bring a lawsuit is to take legal action
an old sense means to woo or seek in marriage
a girl's name, short for Susan

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to bring a legal action, archaically to woo, and is also a girl's name.

clue.text: Novel theory of retirement after working

indicators.note: working here means being worked or kneaded into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A book setting out a theory about what retirement means after a working life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' is just a link word between the fodder and the indicator 'working'.
explanation.definitionFit: James Jones's 1951 book about soldiers in Hawaii before Pearl Harbor is a famous novel.

clue.text: Garden tool used around yard by northern tomboy

indicators.note: the garden tool is placed around the abbreviation for yard

parts.note: a hoe is a long-handled garden tool for weeding

explanation.surface: A boisterous girl from the north uses a hoe in the yard.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoyden is an old-fashioned word for a boisterous, high-spirited girl.

clue.text: May is here — figure to catch up

parts.note: a number is a figure

indicators.note: in a down entry up means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: to net a fish is to catch it

explanation.surface: It is May, and someone is trying to catch up on the figures.
explanation.walkthrough: May is Theresa May, British prime minister 2016-19; Number Ten Downing Street is the PM's residence.
explanation.definitionFit: The prime minister's London residence is where Theresa May lived while in office.

clue.text: Strong desire to have time with modern British artist

parts.note: Damien Hirst is a contemporary British artist known for his pickled shark

explanation.surface: Someone longs to spend time with a fashionable British artist.
explanation.definitionFit: A thirst is a craving or strong desire, by extension from the need for drink.

clue.text: Trendy joint

definitions.meaning: the ball-and-socket joint at the top of the leg

explanation.definitionFit: The word means fashionable in slang and also names the joint between thigh and pelvis.

clue.text: Glass component of lock

definitions.meaning: the pivoting part in a lock that a key must lift

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a straight drinking glass and the lever inside a lock that the key moves.

clue.text: Where to get cleaner putting brush around at hotel

indicators.note: the brush is put around the next two pieces

parts.note: a broom is a long-handled brush
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A cleaner sweeps around a hotel with a broom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cleaner' is not a person with a brush but the adjective: the room where you get cleaner.
explanation.definitionFit: A bathroom is the room where you wash, so where you become cleaner.

clue.text: Asian person and English briefly visiting island

indicators.note: visiting means staying within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Bali is an Indonesian island
ENG is the short form of English

explanation.surface: An Asian person and an English traveller pay a brief visit to an island.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bengali is a native of Bengal, in Bangladesh and eastern India.

clue.text: Knight detained by Middle-Eastern country jailer

indicators.note: detained by means held inside the country's name

parts.note: Turkey straddles Europe and the Middle East
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A knight is held prisoner in a Middle Eastern country.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnkey is an old word for a prison warder, who turns the key in the cell lock.

clue.text: Sample mince pies cooked — one missing

indicators.note: cooked suggests something prepared or altered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone tries a batch of freshly baked mince pies, but one has gone.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of MINCE PIES, rearranged, make the answer plus one I; 'missing' says that I is left over.
explanation.definitionFit: A specimen is an example or sample taken for study or display.

clue.text: Swagger in bar

definitions.meaning: to walk with a proud, conceited gait
a rod or brace in a framework

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to walk with a swagger and also names a supporting bar in a structure.

clue.text: Tell high-ranking churchman to dismiss priest initially

indicators.note: to dismiss means to send away, so a letter is removed

parts.note: a prelate is a bishop or other senior cleric

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of the word priest

explanation.surface: A senior cleric is told to sack a priest.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate a story is to tell or recount it.

clue.text: Again charge football official with evil

parts.note: a ref, short for referee, officiates a football match
ill can mean evil or harm, as in 'ill will'

explanation.surface: A referee is again accused of wickedness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charge' looks like an accusation but means to fill up, as with a glass or battery.
explanation.definitionFit: To refill is to fill up once more, as in recharging a glass.

clue.text: Provoke trouble with vocal quartet in a comedy item

indicators.note: the vocal piece goes inside the comedy item

parts.note: a skit is a short comic sketch

indicators.note: vocal means spoken, so the number word is used by its sound

parts.note: a quartet is a group of four

explanation.surface: A barbershop quartet in a comedy sketch is courting trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To ask for it is an idiom meaning to invite or provoke trouble by one's behaviour.

clue.text: See 13
Antelope's short dash

indicators.note: short means the word is cut off before its last letter

parts.note: the eland is a large African antelope; the 's is a link meaning 'is'

explanation.surface: An antelope makes a quick sprint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dash' looks like a run but means flair.
explanation.definitionFit: Elan and dash both mean flair, style and vigorous spirit.
